questions.questionText: Consider the names of the following Mughal emperors of the Eighteenth century: (i) Alamgir II (ii) Ahmad Shah (iii) Jahandar Shah (iv) Muhammad shah. Which among the following sequences represents the correct chronological order of these Mughal emperors?
questions.explanation: Exact repetition of the June 2012 question. Chronology: Jahandar Shah (1712-1713), Muhammad Shah (1719-1748), Ahmad Shah (1748-1754), Alamgir II (1754-1759).

questions.questionText: Place the following events in chronological order: (i) Introduction of the dagh system (ii) Battle of Haldighati (iii) Construction of Ibadat Khana (iv) Promulgation of Mahzar. Which code is correct?
questions.explanation: Introduction of Dagh system (1573-74), Construction of Ibadat Khana (1575), Battle of Haldighati (June 1576), Promulgation of Mahzar (1579).
